item.title: Top 5 Steps to Fix Blazor Authentication Issues with OpenID Connect in .NET 8
item.description: In this guide, we will explore how to troubleshoot and resolve Blazor authentication issues with OpenID Connect in .NET 8. Blazor’s integration with identity servers, especially using OpenID Connect and Duende Identity Server, can sometimes lead to unexpected behavior, such as not automatically redirecting users to the login page after they log out. By following these steps, you can ensure a smoother and more secure authentication experience for your users.

item.title: Top 5 Steps to Log Out in Blazor with Azure AD Authentication
item.description:
Setting up proper logout functionality in a Blazor Server application integrated with Azure AD authentication can be tricky. Unlike some built-in solutions, Azure AD sign-out requires a bit of custom configuration to ensure users are properly logged out and redirected as intended. This guide walks you through the essential steps to correctly implement the logout process using Azure AD in Blazor Server.

Top 5 Steps to Log Out in Blazor with Azure AD Authentication

1. Configure Azure AD in Your Application

First, ensure that your Azure AD configuration is properly set up. This involves registering your app in Azure and configuring it to use OpenID Connect (OIDC) for authentication.
